description: This file defines the MemberPermissions React component, which manages displaying and editing permissions for team members within a UI. It interacts with backend API calls to fetch and update permissions and uses various UI elements such as tables, checkboxes, and buttons for user interaction.

methods.name: fetchPermissions
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches team permissions from the backend and updates the component state.

methods.name: handlePermissionChange
methods.description: Handles toggling of individual permission checkboxes, updating selected permissions and tracking changes.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current set of selected permissions to the backend and provides user notifications.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets permissions to the last fetched state by re-fetching permissions from backend.
